name: dynamic-todos-sessions
description: Logs each Claude Code session as a task in Dynamic Todos, under an agent named for this computer, and sets off its follow-up alarm whenever Claude needs you.

computer.title: This computer's name
computer.description: The Dynamic Todos agent this computer's sessions go under, e.g. Gaming PC. Blank uses the computer's own name.

token.title: Dynamic Todos token
token.description: The app's CLAUDE_QUEUE_TOKEN (the same one the Send to Claude queue uses).
